result.instructions: Tools for Hugging Face, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Search the Hub for Llama models and show the top matches."; "Which Spaces can turn a photo into a cartoon?"; "Which papers on the Hub match 'retrieval-augmented generation'?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hugging Face data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run huggingface_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run huggingface_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run huggingface_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. huggingface_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: huggingface_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Show the Hugging Face account this token belongs to and the token's role. Good first call to confirm the connection. Hub API: GET /api/whoami-v2.

tools.name: huggingface_get_credits
tools.title: Get my credits
tools.description: Show the account's credits balance (USD), billing mode and the purchased, granted and monthly included balances with expiry dates. Hub API: GET /api/settings/billing/credits.

tools.name: huggingface_get_organization_credits
tools.title: Get organization credits
tools.description: Show an organization's credits balance and billing mode. Needs a token with access to billing for that organization. Hub API: GET /api/organizations/{name}/billing/credits.

organization.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

tools.name: huggingface_list_organization_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: List the members of an organization, with optional search by name. Needs an organization admin token. Hub API: GET /api/organizations/{name}/members.

organization.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

search.description: Filter members by username or name.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: huggingface_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List the account's notifications (discussions, pull requests, papers, mentions), newest first. Hub API: GET /api/notifications.

readStatus.description: Show all notifications or only unread ones.

repoType.description: Only notifications for this repository kind.

mention.description: Filter by how the account is involved.

tools.name: huggingface_quicksearch
tools.title: Quick search the Hub
tools.description: Search the Hub for models, datasets, Spaces, users, papers and collections with one query. Pass type to narrow the kinds, for example model or dataset. Hub API: GET /api/quicksearch.

query.description: Search text, for example a model name or topic.

type.description: Result kinds to include, for example ["model"] or ["dataset"].

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: huggingface_search_spaces
tools.title: Search Spaces
tools.description: Semantic search over Hugging Face Spaces (demo apps), by what they do. Optionally filter by category and include Spaces that are not running. Hub API: GET /api/spaces/semantic-search.

query.description: What the Space should do, in plain words.

category.description: Category filter, for example text-generation or image-generation.

includeNonRunning.description: Also return Spaces that are not running now.

tools.name: huggingface_search_papers
tools.title: Search papers
tools.description: Search research papers indexed on Hugging Face (hybrid semantic and full-text search). Hub API: GET /api/papers/search.

query.description: Search text, for example a method or a task.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: huggingface_get_paper
tools.title: Get a paper
tools.description: Get one paper by its arXiv-style id (for example 2310.06825). Optionally add comments or the submission deadline. Hub API: GET /api/papers/{paperId}.

tools.name: huggingface_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List or search Hub collections (curated lists of models, datasets, Spaces and papers), by text, owner or sort order. Hub API: GET /api/collections.

query.description: Search text for the collection title or description.

owner.description: Only collections owned by these users or organizations.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: huggingface_get_collection
tools.title: Get a collection
tools.description: Get one collection with its items. The URL slug is the collection's name part plus its id (for example slug 'semantic-search', id 'abc123'). Hub API: GET /api/collections/{namespace}/{slug}-{id}.

namespace.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

slug.description: Collection name part of the URL slug, without the id.

id.description: Collection id, the last part of the URL slug.

tools.name: huggingface_get_user_overview
tools.title: Get a user overview
tools.description: Show a public user's profile overview: name, Pro status and counts of their models, datasets, Spaces and discussions. Hub API: GET /api/users/{username}/overview.

username.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

tools.name: huggingface_list_user_likes
tools.title: List a user's likes
tools.description: List the public repositories (models, datasets, Spaces and others) a user has liked, with pagination. Hub API: GET /api/users/{username}/likes.

username.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: huggingface_list_repo_files
tools.title: List repository files
tools.description: List the files and folders of a model, dataset or Space at a branch or revision, optionally inside one folder. Leave path empty for the root. Hub API: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}/tree/{rev}/{path}.

namespace.description: Hugging Face user or organization name, as shown in its URL.

revision.description: Branch, tag or commit. Default: main.

path.description: Folder inside the repository. Empty or omitted means the root.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.
